publish.rationale: In-window delta: NCSC-CH advisory (2026-07-10 08:55Z) escalates CVE-2026-20896 exploitation status to 'Actively Exploited, PoC Available'. Core vuln covered 2026-06-23; this is the exploitation-status change (update-note rule). Honest caveat: only public telemetry (Sysdig via SecurityWeek/THN, 07-06) is recon-only — surface the divergence.

Distinct actor cluster (BlackFile/UNC6671 + ShinyHunters lineage), multi-source (ReliaQuest 07-08 + BleepingComputer 07-09). Delta vs morning M365-CA research entry: manager-impersonation vishing front-end, MFA-registration persistence, python-requests automated SharePoint enumeration/exfil, actor attribution, containment-evasion. Cross-links M365 CA entry via references[]. EU public-sector SharePoint/Entra stack directly reachable.

Novel supply-chain evasion technique (Aikido 07-09): runtime-triggered credential hooking with NO install-time (postinstall) hook, defeating install-time SCA scanners; transitive scope poisoning (17 packages); protocol-mimicking exfil. Clears PD-11(d) — materially improves what a dependency-scanning defender can detect/hunt. Framed on transferable technique, not the crypto package. Single-source reputable lab.

Fresh observed technique (SANS ISC 07-10): ~2.5MB HTML phishing attachment padded with ~430k repeated chars to dilute/exhaust AI/NLP email classifiers (or token-budget DoS an LLM scanner). Relevant to public-sector mail gateways increasingly running AI content scoring. Concrete non-AI-fallback detection + hardening. Single sample, author hypothesis (hedged).
